excerpts.interpretation: The true inpaint UNet receives the latent, mask and encoded masked image as nine channels.
Original-latent reinsertion is guarded by four input channels. This further implementation difference is intentionally not changed in V9.

nativeComparison.interpretation: NearestMax downsamples the latent conditioning mask; the later 3x3 dilation supplies the denoise mask. V9 changes only the SDXL Inpaint downsampling mode, leaving the denoise-blending algorithm present.
